subject.title: [Bug]: codex harness mirrored-session-history read fails for ephemeral sessions and on failover; one-shot cleanup retires shared app-server client while turns are in flight

question: Should the remaining fix be limited to Codex mirrored-history parsing/diagnostics plus active-memory repro, or should it also change model-fallback transcript handoff semantics for replay-safe Codex failures?
rationale: The source shows the warning and active-memory path still exist, but the fallback behavior is a policy boundary because OpenClaw must avoid replaying side-effecting or partially delivered turns.

options.title: Verify then narrow the fix
options.body: First prove the active-memory and `session_meta` cases on current main, then repair mirrored-history diagnostics/parsing and only adjust fallback for replay-safe no-delivery failures.

options.title: Broaden fallback continuity now
options.body: Treat Codex app-server failover as a transcript-handoff problem immediately, accepting a larger compatibility and replay-safety review surface.

options.title: Split into canonical follow-ups
options.body: Move active-memory timeout work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/100167 and keep this issue only for Codex `session_meta` mirrored-history handling.

recommendation.title: Verify then narrow the fix
recommendation.body: First prove the active-memory and `session_meta` cases on current main, then repair mirrored-history diagnostics/parsing and only adjust fallback for replay-safe no-delivery failures.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current missing-history fix and has recent history in the Codex app-server cleanup and runtime areas that would own the narrowest follow-up.
